architect_rationale: INS-4-001: The approved plan's WP1/WP2 scope rested on a 'code-pinned' claim that a smooth per-image residual R_j (reproducing exact_total across deep-unresolved near-cusp/near-fold sub-bands) was already produced by the existing numba _dd/_hyp1f1 path. The Inspector confirms this primitive (transition_envelopes / image_amplification_factor / _dd_image / _kernel_from_image_amplification) does not exist anywhere in the tree: the engine only exposes the cluster-total F(w) (operator.F_op/F_op_grid) and a per-image geometric kernel (geometry.image_kernel) that is explicitly invalid inside an unresolved cluster -- the exact regime of the crown config's hardest sub-bands. This is not a missed line of code inside channels.py/likelihood.py; it is a falsified premise about what the engine layer can currently supply. Producing an actual smooth envelope/carrier decomposition that provably reconstructs exact_total through near-cusp/near-fold anchors is new physics/numerics work belonging in the engine (operator/_hyp1f1/_gauge), and its existence and stability there is unproven -- exactly the 'KEY CORRECTNESS RISK' the plan itself flagged as unresolved. The Coder and Test Developer correctly refused to fabricate an unverifiable oracle inside the forbidden likelihood layer and escalated rather than shipping a wrong result; that refusal should stand, not be overridden or treated as a fixable implementation bug.

findings.description: Build-3e primary objective is UNMET: WP1 (ChangRefsdalChannels.transition_envelopes) and WP2 (envelope+carrier reconstruction in _amplification_coefficients) did not land; channels.py and likelihood.py are unchanged and the 10 ms warm-lnlike gate is not addressed. Root cause is a falsified plan premise: the approved plan's 'code-pinned' finding claims transition_envelopes / image_amplification_factor / _dd_image / _kernel_from_image_amplification already produce a smooth per-image wave-optics residual R_j — none exist in the tree. The engine produces only the cluster TOTAL F(w) (operator.F_op/F_op_grid) plus the DIVERGENT geometric per-image kernel geometry.image_kernel (explicitly invalid inside an unresolved cluster). A smooth per-image R_j reproducing exact_total across the deep-unresolved near-cusp/near-fold band is the unsolved envelope decomposition itself. Coder+Test-Dev correctly refused to fabricate it (unverifiable invented oracle; needs new physics in forbidden files) and escalated. This is the design escalation the brief's step-rule contemplates, but the build cannot be certified PASS with the objective unmet and no WP1/WP2 diff.
findings.suggested_fix: Escalate to owner/Professor: produce the ACTUAL beat-free envelope decomposition K_a(w) = sum_pairs E_ab(w)*exp(-i*w*Delta_ab) with C-infinity envelopes and config-independent node count, or spec the per-image wave-optics residual primitive as a separately-reviewed WP in chang_refsdal (operator/_hyp1f1/_gauge), before WP1/WP2 in channels.py/likelihood.py can proceed. Do not fabricate R_j in the likelihood layer.
